blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH started because traditional too
blocks_element.text: LIVFRESH started because traditional toothpaste simply wasn’t working. Our founder, Amit Goswamy, was brushing, flossing and rinsing twice a day and still dealing with plaque buildup, bad breath and bleeding gums. The habits weren’t the problem. The product was.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Traditional toothpaste relies on abrasiv
blocks_element.text: Traditional toothpaste relies on abrasives and friction to clean your teeth, which makes it hard to clean along the gumline and in tight spaces, exactly where plaque builds up. So Amit and our chief scientist spent over a decade developing a different approach.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · The result is Activated Edathamil, our p
blocks_element.text: The result is Activated Edathamil, our patented ingredient. While you brush, it works on a molecular level to help break up and unglue plaque, so brushing lifts it away easily. It’s a superior clean without any abrasives.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is backed by over $20 million i
blocks_element.text: LIVFRESH is backed by over $20 million in R&D, 40+ research studies at top U.S. universities, 40 global patents, and research grants from the U.S. Department of Defense and the National Institutes of Health. Proudly made in the USA, trusted by over 1 million customers, and supported by nearly 3,000 dentists and hygienists.

blocks_element.text: While you brush: our patented Activated Edathamil works on a molecular level to help break up and unglue plaque, so brushing lifts it away, even along the gumline and in tight spaces where traditional toothpaste struggles.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · After you brush: brushing with LIVFRESH
blocks_element.text: After you brush: brushing with LIVFRESH leaves a clean tooth surface and helps keep teeth cleaner for longer between brushings.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · All of our fluoride-free gels are powere
blocks_element.text: All of our fluoride-free gels are powered by the same patented Activated Edathamil. Choose based on flavor and feel:
Wintergreen (foaming): our #1 bestseller. Refreshing wintergreen with a satisfying foam.
Peppermint (non-foaming): classic peppermint in a smooth, non-foaming gel.
Mild Peppermint (non-foaming, dye-free): our gentlest routine. No foam, no dye, a soft peppermint flavor, and safe to swallow.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Arctic Peppermint (foaming): a cool, str
blocks_element.text: Arctic Peppermint (foaming): a cool, strong peppermint for extra-fresh breath.
Kids+ Bubblegum (non-foaming, dye-free): the same science-backed clean, specifically formulated for kids. See the Kids+ section below.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · All are fluoride-free, made with safe in
blocks_element.text: All are fluoride-free, made with safe ingredients, and free from SLS, parabens, phthalates, abrasives, peroxide and Triclosan.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · How does LIVFRESH compare to other tooth
blocks_element.text: How does LIVFRESH compare to other toothpastes?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Most toothpastes rely on abrasives and f
blocks_element.text: Most toothpastes rely on abrasives and friction to scrub plaque off your teeth. LIVFRESH takes a different approach. Our patented Activated Edathamil works on a molecular level to help break up and unglue plaque, so brushing lifts it away easily. It’s a superior clean without any abrasives.

Bouton · Why is LIVFRESH priced the way it is?
blocks_element.text: Why is LIVFRESH priced the way it is?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is engineered, not just formula
blocks_element.text: LIVFRESH is engineered, not just formulated. Our patented Activated Edathamil took over a decade of research and over $20 million in R&D to develop, and every tube is made in the USA. It’s backed by 40 global patents and 40+ research studies at top U.S. universities, which are the gold standard of research, but also the most expensive.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · On a per-use basis, LIVFRESH comes out t
blocks_element.text: On a per-use basis, LIVFRESH comes out to about $0.20 per brushing, less than a cup of coffee. Our Subscribe & Save program and current offers are the best ways to save. If cost is a concern, reach out. We’re passionate about making better oral care accessible to everyone.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · What is a gel toothpaste?
Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is a pressure-release gel, not
blocks_element.text: LIVFRESH is a pressure-release gel, not a thick, opaque paste. As you brush, the gel releases and spreads evenly across your teeth and into tight spaces. It feels different at first, and that’s the point.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Does LIVFRESH help with enamel or remine
blocks_element.text: Does LIVFRESH help with enamel or remineralization?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Our fluoride-free gels are made for enam
blocks_element.text: Our fluoride-free gels are made for enamel care, without abrasives: a superior clean with no scrubbing, powered by our patented Activated Edathamil.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · If remineralization and cavity protectio
blocks_element.text: If remineralization and cavity protection are what you’re looking for, we recommend Gum Protect+. It’s powered by clinically proven stannous fluoride, which strengthens enamel, helps remineralize teeth and aids in the prevention of cavities. Gum Protect+ is clinically proven to remineralize better than nano-hydroxyapatite toothpaste.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Does LIVFRESH whiten teeth? Will it stai
blocks_element.text: Does LIVFRESH whiten teeth? Will it stain?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Brushing with LIVFRESH whitens teeth, wi
blocks_element.text: Brushing with LIVFRESH whitens teeth, without peroxides, and our gels won’t stain your teeth. For dedicated whitening, try our Coconut Whitening Strips.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Fluoride-free is your preference and you
blocks_element.text: Fluoride-free is your preference and you want a powerful daily clean: choose any of our fluoride-free gels.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · You want stannous fluoride’s gum and cav
blocks_element.text: You want stannous fluoride’s gum and cavity benefits plus enhanced cleaning: choose Gum Protect+.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Best of both: some customers use a fluor
blocks_element.text: Best of both: some customers use a fluoride-free gel in the morning and Gum Protect+ at night.

blocks_element.text: Gel toothpaste (twice daily): choose the formula that fits your needs. Brushing with Activated Edathamil helps break up plaque so brushing lifts it away.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Mouthwash (after brushing): the same pat
blocks_element.text: Mouthwash (after brushing): the same patented technology in liquid form. It helps rinse buildup away before it hardens into tartar and reaches the areas your brush may miss. As part of your brushing routine, it delivers 163% better tartar control than a leading mouthwash brand.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Coconut Whitening Strips (as needed): br
blocks_element.text: Coconut Whitening Strips (as needed): brush first, dry your teeth, then apply for 20–30 minutes. Brushing with LIVFRESH first leaves a cleaner surface, which helps the whitening work more effectively.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Where are LIVFRESH products made?
Paragraphe · Our gel toothpastes and Mouthwash are pr
blocks_element.text: Our gel toothpastes and Mouthwash are proudly made in the USA, and LIVFRESH was formulated by scientists that graduated from Berkeley and Stanford. We keep manufacturing in the USA to ensure the highest quality standards, even though it costs more than manufacturing abroad.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Can you explain the science behind LIVFR
blocks_element.text: Can you explain the science behind LIVFRESH?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is powered by our patented Acti
blocks_element.text: LIVFRESH is powered by our patented Activated Edathamil, developed over a decade of research and more than $20 million in R&D. While you brush, Activated Edathamil works on a molecular level to help break up and unglue plaque, so brushing lifts it away, even along the gumline and in tight spaces. Brushing with LIVFRESH also helps keep teeth cleaner for longer between brushings.

blocks_element.text: Are there any ingredient concerns I should know about?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Propylene glycol: a common ingredient th
blocks_element.text: Propylene glycol: a common ingredient that keeps the gel smooth and stable, found in many toothpastes and widely used in food and pharmaceutical applications. It’s sometimes confused with ethylene glycol (antifreeze), but they’re completely different ingredients.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Activated Edathamil: our patented ingred
blocks_element.text: Activated Edathamil: our patented ingredient. While you brush, it helps break up and unglue plaque so brushing lifts it away, with no abrasives.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Stevia: a natural sweetener. No sugar an
blocks_element.text: Stevia: a natural sweetener. No sugar and no artificial sweeteners.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · FD&C Blue 1: a safe color additive that
blocks_element.text: FD&C Blue 1: a safe color additive that helps you see you’re using a pea-sized amount. Mild Peppermint and Kids+ Bubblegum are dye-free. (On Arctic Peppermint it’s listed as Brilliant Blue FCF, the same color additive.)

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate: a gentle, SLS
blocks_element.text: Sodium Cocoyl Isethionate: a gentle, SLS-free foaming agent used in our foaming formulas (Wintergreen, Arctic Peppermint and Gum Protect+). Peppermint, Mild Peppermint and Kids+ Bubblegum are non-foaming.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Questions about a specific ingredient? R
blocks_element.text: Questions about a specific ingredient? Reach out anytime.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Why do some formulas foam and others don
blocks_element.text: Why do some formulas foam and others don’t?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Foam doesn’t clean; brushing with our pa
blocks_element.text: Foam doesn’t clean; brushing with our patented formula does. Many people are sensitive to foaming agents, and foam isn’t needed for the clean, so we offer both. Our foaming formulas use a mild, coconut-derived foaming agent called sodium cocoyl isethionate (not SLS). Our non-foaming formulas (Peppermint, Mild Peppermint and Kids+) skip it entirely.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH free of toxic metals?
blocks_element.text: Is LIVFRESH free of toxic metals?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. LIVFRESH has undergone independent,
blocks_element.text: Yes. LIVFRESH has undergone independent, third-party toxic metal testing using ED-XRF (energy-dispersive X-ray fluorescence), which can detect heavy metals down to parts-per-million. Our gel toothpastes came back non-detectable for arsenic, lead, mercury and cadmium.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Our gels use natural flavoring ingredien
blocks_element.text: Our gels use natural flavoring ingredients (like peppermint, menthol, wintergreen and bubblegum) for taste, not added fragrance. For the mildest flavor, try Mild Peppermint.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Are LIVFRESH ingredients ethically sourc
Paragraphe · Yes. We’re committed to responsible sour
blocks_element.text: Yes. We’re committed to responsible sourcing. Our products are cruelty-free, vegan and proudly made in the USA. If you have a specific sourcing question, we’re happy to look into it.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · How do I use the gel toothpaste?
blocks_element.text: How do I use the gel toothpaste?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Apply a pea-sized amount to a wet or dry
blocks_element.text: Apply a pea-sized amount to a wet or dry brush.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Don’t wet the brush after applying. The
blocks_element.text: Don’t wet the brush after applying. The gel is water-soluble and will dissolve off the bristles.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Spread the gel across all your teeth, th
blocks_element.text: Spread the gel across all your teeth, then brush at a 45-degree angle with a soft-to-medium brush for 2 minutes (about 30 seconds per quadrant). Don’t forget the backs of your teeth and your tongue.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Store the tube on its cap so the gel sit
blocks_element.text: Store the tube on its cap so the gel sits at the tip.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Works with manual and electric brushes.
blocks_element.text: Works with manual and electric brushes. With an electric brush, spread the gel across your teeth first, then switch it on.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Each tube lasts about 4–6 weeks with twi
blocks_element.text: Each tube lasts about 4–6 weeks with twice-daily use.

blocks_element.text: How do I know it’s working?

blocks_element.repere: Texte · First brush: run your tongue over your t
blocks_element.text: First brush: run your tongue over your teeth. They should feel noticeably smoother and cleaner.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Morning breath: brush with LIVFRESH at n
blocks_element.text: Morning breath: brush with LIVFRESH at night and notice how your breath feels the next morning.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Over the following weeks: teeth that sta
blocks_element.text: Over the following weeks: teeth that stay cleaner for longer between brushings, fresher breath, and less buildup over time.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · With Gum Protect+: you may see less pink
blocks_element.text: With Gum Protect+: you may see less pink in the sink over time.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · At your next cleaning: your hygienist ma
blocks_element.text: At your next cleaning: your hygienist may notice the difference!

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · How should I store LIVFRESH?
Paragraphe · Store at room temperature, out of direct
blocks_element.text: Store at room temperature, out of direct sunlight, in a dry place, and secure the cap after each use. No special storage is required.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · If you receive the tube in a cold winter
blocks_element.text: If you receive the tube in a cold winter or hot summer, keep it at room temperature for 6 hours before opening.

blocks_element.text: LIVFRESH is made for everyday use and doesn’t require a prescription. We always encourage keeping your dentist in the loop, especially if you have specific concerns or are undergoing treatment. LIVFRESH is supported by nearly 3,000 dentists and hygienists, so your dentist may already know us.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Can I use LIVFRESH on my pet?
blocks_element.text: Can I use LIVFRESH on my pet?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · We have a lot of customers who use our M
blocks_element.text: We have a lot of customers who use our Mild Peppermint on their dogs. It’s non-foaming, dye-free, safe to swallow and made with safe, food-grade ingredients, which is why so many pet parents reach for it. Very importantly it does not contain Xylitol which is toxic to dogs and cats. That said, LIVFRESH wasn’t formulated to be a pet toothpaste, so please check with your vet first and start with a very small amount, since some animals can be sensitive to menthol.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · What can I expect when using LIVFRESH?
blocks_element.text: What can I expect when using LIVFRESH?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · From your first brush: your teeth feel n
blocks_element.text: From your first brush: your teeth feel noticeably smoother and cleaner, like you just left a professional cleaning. Run your tongue over your teeth: no more fuzzy feeling.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · With consistent brushing: LIVFRESH helps
blocks_element.text: With consistent brushing: LIVFRESH helps keep your teeth cleaner for longer between brushings, and you may notice fresher breath (especially in the morning) and less plaque buildup over time. Brushing with LIVFRESH also helps reduce tartar build-up.

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · With Gum Protect+: it helps control blee
blocks_element.text: With Gum Protect+: it helps control bleeding gums associated with gingivitis, so if your gums bleed when you brush, you may see less pink in the sink over time.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Each tube lasts about 4–6 weeks with twi
blocks_element.text: Each tube lasts about 4–6 weeks with twice-daily, pea-sized use.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · Apply a pea-sized amount to a wet or dry
blocks_element.text: Apply a pea-sized amount to a wet or dry brush, and don’t wet the brush again after applying.

blocks_element.repere: Texte · No foam in our non-foaming formulas is c
blocks_element.text: No foam in our non-foaming formulas is completely normal. Foam doesn’t clean; brushing with our patented formula does.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Can I use LIVFRESH if I have sensitive t
blocks_element.text: Can I use LIVFRESH if I have sensitive teeth?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · We always recommend checking with your d
blocks_element.text: We always recommend checking with your dentist about tooth sensitivity. Our gels are abrasive-free and SLS-free, for an enamel-friendly clean, and if other toothpastes feel too harsh, LIVFRESH is a great alternative. For our gentlest option, try Mild Peppermint: no foam, no dye and a soft peppermint flavor. If you already use a sensitivity toothpaste, you can keep using it as your dentist recommends.

blocks_element.text: Is LIVFRESH safe during pregnancy or menopause?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Please check with your doctor or dentist
blocks_element.text: Please check with your doctor or dentist first, especially during pregnancy. Our fluoride-free gels are made with safe ingredients. Gum Protect+ contains stannous fluoride, so standard fluoride toothpaste directions apply. For our Mouthwash, check with your healthcare provider before use. If you’re noticing bleeding gums, Gum Protect+ helps control bleeding gums associated with gingivitis.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH safe if I have a medical con
blocks_element.text: Is LIVFRESH safe if I have a medical condition?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Our gels are abrasive-free and SLS-free,
blocks_element.text: Our gels are abrasive-free and SLS-free, and our fluoride-free formulas are made with safe ingredients. Because every situation is unique, please check with your healthcare provider or dentist before starting any new oral care product.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH appropriate during chemo or
blocks_element.text: Is LIVFRESH appropriate during chemo or radiation?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Every patient’s situation is unique, esp

If you’re looking for our gentlest option, Mild Peppermint is abrasive-free and SLS-free, with no foam and no dye. This community is close to our hearts, and we’re here to help however we can.

blocks_element.text: Is LIVFRESH suitable for kids with sensory sensitivities?

blocks_element.text: Yes. Kids+ Bubblegum and Mild Peppermint both have no foam and no dye, are safe to swallow, and are made with safe, food-grade ingredients. We always recommend adult supervision and checking with your child’s dentist for personalized guidance.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Is LIVFRESH safe for caps, bridges, vene
blocks_element.text: Is LIVFRESH safe for caps, bridges, veneers, braces and dental work?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · LIVFRESH is abrasive-free, so it’s gentl
blocks_element.text: LIVFRESH is abrasive-free, so it’s gentle on caps, crowns, bridges, veneers, dentures, fillings, implants and braces. For braces, we recommend a foaming formula (Wintergreen or Arctic Peppermint) for easy spreading around brackets, plus our Mouthwash, which reaches the areas your brush may miss.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Can I use LIVFRESH with Invisalign or a
blocks_element.text: Can I use LIVFRESH with Invisalign or a nightguard?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Brushing with LIVFRESH before putti
blocks_element.text: Yes. Brushing with LIVFRESH before putting your aligners or nightguard in starts you off with a noticeably cleaner mouth, and LIVFRESH helps keep teeth cleaner for longer between brushings. A quick rinse with our Mouthwash after brushing adds an extra layer of freshness. User feedback indicates that brushing with LIVFRESH reduces the odor that can be caused or is common with Invisalign and mouthguards.

blocks_element.repere: Bouton · Can I use the Mouthwash with braces, ali
blocks_element.text: Can I use the Mouthwash with braces, aligners or other dental appliances?

blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. Rinse with LIVFRESH Mouthwash as pa
blocks_element.text: Yes. Rinse with LIVFRESH Mouthwash as part of your regular routine. For aligners, a quick rinse after brushing and before reinserting them adds an extra layer of freshness. Check with your dentist or orthodontist for specific guidance.
